Question h11:
Of the persistent entity types defined in the data layer, which one is referenced from the largest number of packages outside that layer? Rank the top two.
Answer format: 1st: Type; 2nd: Type (with rough package counts)

display: Mapped the project tree — 47 files in 12 folders
Checked what changing Memo would affect
Checked what changing User would affect
Checked what changing Attachment would affect

content:
h11.

**1st: User** (referenced from ~6 packages outside `store/`: `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/rss`)

**2nd: Memo** (referenced from ~4 packages outside `store/`: `server/router/api/v1`, `server/notification`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`)

Basis: ran `[ArchMap query]` and `[ArchMap query]` (plus the other persistent entities defined in `store/*.go` — `Attachment`, `Reaction`, `Inbox`, `MemoRelation`, `MemoShare`, `IdentityProvider`, `UserSetting`) and grouped the direct-reach edges by file, then rolled files up into their containing Go packages, excluding the data layer itself (`store/`, `store/db/*`, `store/migration/*`).

- `store.User` (defined `store/user.go:29`) fans out into `server/router/api/v1/user_service.go`, `server/auth/authenticator.go`, `server/auth/context.go`, `server/notification/email.go`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go`, `server/router/rss/rss.go`, `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go`, plus several more `server/router/api/v1/*` files (converters, instance_service, shortcut_service, sso, session, etc.) — the widest spread of consuming packages of any entity checked.
- `store.Memo` (defined `store/memo.go:35`) fans out into `server/notification/email.go`, `server/router/api/v1/*` (mention helpers, converter, update helpers, sse helpers, batch helpers, relation/attachment services), `server/router/rss/rss.go`, and `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` — fewer distinct packages than `User` (no `server/auth`, no test package), but still broad.

Everything else checked (`Attachment`, `MemoShare`, `Inbox` at ~2 packages; `UserSetting`, `IdentityProvider`, `MemoRelation`, `Reaction` at ~1 package) trails well behind these two.

Note: `[ArchMap query]` results are edge counts from direct dependency rows (`store/*.go` and dialect-specific `store/db/{mysql,postgres,sqlite}/*.go` excluded as "the data layer"); the tool's own note flags `~writes/~reads` as a lower bound since string-concatenated SQL isn't captured — so these counts could be a slight undercount, but the relative ranking (User > Memo > the rest) is clear from the breadth of distinct external packages touched.
